title: The part window footer shows Delete Part, Cancel and Save
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-FOOTER-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Scroll to the bottom of the window.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: a thin line runs above the footer. "Delete Part" sits at the left: a red button with a white trash icon and a white label.
  • Step 3: at the right sit Cancel (white, with a grey outline and a dark label) and then Save (blue, with a white label).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-R6, S13-R7, S13-R8, S13-R9, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The part as it stands), board 3.1 (Part Status in the dialog), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R6: “The footer has a thin line above it. "Delete Part" sits at its left; Cancel and Save sit at its right.”
  • S13-R7: “"Delete Part" is the design system's danger button: red, with a white trash icon and white label.”
  • S13-R8: “Cancel is the design system's secondary button: white, with a grey outline and dark label. It closes the dialog without saving.”
  • S13-R9: “Save is the design system's primary button: blue, with a white label.”
